pages: Taine Hollis, thirty-six, short brown hair, a charcoal canvas work jacket over a grey checked shirt and brown work boots, sets one hard case down on the workshop floor and looks along the machine bays. Middle distance: a folded tripod and a tool bag. Background: a steel shed door standing open, morning daylight on concrete.

Taine Hollis, thirty-six, short brown hair, a charcoal canvas work jacket over a grey checked shirt and brown work boots, holds one small cylindrical acoustic calibrator against the microphone of a sound level meter, watching it, the case open at his feet. Middle distance: a tripod leg and a clipboard. Background: the workshop floor, cold daylight.

Taine Hollis, thirty-six, short brown hair, a charcoal canvas work jacket over a grey checked shirt and brown work boots, stands beside one sound level meter on a tripod at head height, pencil against a book, reading the small display. Middle distance: the tripod legs and a machine base. Background: the workshop floor, high windows, grey light.

Taine Hollis, thirty-six, short brown hair, a charcoal canvas work jacket over a grey checked shirt and brown work boots, presses one fingertip on the red-painted zone of a folded floor plan on a bench, a pen in his other hand. Middle distance: a hard case and a steel rule. Background: a wall painted in three bands, daylight.

Taine Hollis, thirty-six, short brown hair, a charcoal canvas work jacket over a grey checked shirt and brown work boots, stands at the edge of the saw bench with one hand flat on the extraction hood, listening, the saw just stopped. Middle distance: the saw bench guard and a stack of sheet steel. Background: the workshop, roller door light.

Taine Hollis, thirty-six, short brown hair, a charcoal canvas work jacket over a grey checked shirt and brown work boots, kneels at the press brake and holds one sound level meter up at the operator's position, watching its display. Middle distance: a folded sheet on a crate and the hard case. Background: the bay, strip light, bare floor.

Taine Hollis, thirty-six, short brown hair, a charcoal canvas work jacket over a grey checked shirt and brown work boots, sits on a crate writing one column of small figures down a ruled sheet with a pen, two columns already inked beside it. Middle distance: the meter in its open case and a folding rule. Background: the workshop bench, daylight.

Taine Hollis, thirty-six, short brown hair, a charcoal canvas work jacket over a grey checked shirt and brown work boots, holds one box of ear defenders up in one hand and reads the rating printed on the side. Middle distance: two more boxes on the shelf and a time clock. Background: the workshop wall, daylight, zone bands behind.

Taine Hollis, thirty-six, short brown hair, a charcoal canvas work jacket over a grey checked shirt and brown work boots, sits at a bench reading one sheet of a typed table, the sound level meter standing beside him. Middle distance: a laptop and the open hard case. Background: a small site office, window light, drawings pinned up.

Taine Hollis, thirty-six, short brown hair, a charcoal canvas work jacket over a grey checked shirt and brown work boots, kneels close to the press brake guard with one hand on the guard rail and the meter held near the machine's head height. Middle distance: a foot pedal and a stack of blanks. Background: the press brake bay, overhead light.

Denise Riddell, forty-seven, short greying hair, a navy work shirt, sits very still in a soundproof booth with one pair of padded headphones over her ears and her eyes closed. Middle distance: an audiogram printout on a small desk and a microphone stand. Background: a foam-lined booth, soft even light, a door hatch.

Taine Hollis, thirty-six, short brown hair, a charcoal canvas work jacket over a grey checked shirt and brown work boots, lifts one small beige hearing aid out of its case in her palm, looking at it. Middle distance: a telephone and shelves of small parts bins. Background: the stores room, daylight through wired glass, steel shelving behind.

Denise Riddell, forty-seven, short greying hair, a navy work shirt, leaves one sound level meter logging on a tripod beside a work position and checks a second meter held in his hand. Middle distance: the open hard case and a machine guard. Background: the workshop after hours, roller door shut, one work lamp.

Taine Hollis, thirty-six, short brown hair, a charcoal canvas work jacket over a grey checked shirt and brown work boots, crouches inside the narrow press brake bay with one sound level meter held beside the guard rail at head height. Middle distance: the hydraulic pump under the bench and a steel platform. Background: the bay, strip light, close walls.

Taine Hollis, thirty-six, short brown hair, a charcoal canvas work jacket over a grey checked shirt and brown work boots, kneels and holds one sound level meter up against the open mouth of a galvanised extraction duct, watching the display. Middle distance: a flexible duct and a saw bench hood. Background: the workshop wall, roller door daylight, sheet metal stacks.

Taine Hollis, thirty-six, short brown hair, a charcoal canvas work jacket over a grey checked shirt and brown work boots, clamps one clear plastic bag over a small drain cock on the ring main pipe and holds it while it swells. Middle distance: his phone and an isolation valve wheel. Background: the plant room floor, cool window light.

Taine Hollis, thirty-six, short brown hair, a charcoal canvas work jacket over a grey checked shirt and brown work boots, lays one hand flat on the black compressor intake silencer and feels it buzz, the meter standing on the floor behind him. Middle distance: a ring main pipe and a bolted flange. Background: the plant room corner, fluorescent light.

Taine Hollis, thirty-six, short brown hair, a charcoal canvas work jacket over a grey checked shirt and brown work boots, squares one thick bound report on an office desk and writes on its cover sheet, a typed fix list beside it. Middle distance: the meter hard case and a tin mug. Background: the site office, window light, pinned drawings.

Taine Hollis, thirty-six, short brown hair, a charcoal canvas work jacket over a grey checked shirt and brown work boots, stands on a raised steel platform at the press brake with both hands on the control, her head above the guard rail. Middle distance: the hydraulic pump and a foot treadle. Background: the press brake bay, daylight, sheet metal racks.

Denise Riddell, forty-seven, short greying hair, a navy work shirt, writes an hour's figure on one ruled log sheet balanced on a crate, the meter still logging on its tripod beside him. Middle distance: the tripod and the open hard case. Background: the press brake bay before opening, blue dawn light.
